```{ojs}
//| output: false
releaseDescriptor = releaseId => {
  const match = String(releaseId ?? "").match(/_(\d{4})_(\d{2})$/)
  if (!match) return String(releaseId ?? "")
  const year = Number(match[1])
  const month = Number(match[2])
  const monthName = d3.utcFormat("%B")(new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, 1)))
  return year + ", " + monthName
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
isPublishedNumber = row => {
  const status = String(row?.suppression_status ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()
  const value = Number(row?.display_value)
  return (status === "" || status === "none" || status === "not_applicable") && Number.isFinite(value)
}

complete = row => String(row?.period_complete) === "1"

monthKey = row =>
  String(row.period_year).padStart(4, "0") + "-" +
  String(row.period_month).padStart(2, "0")

monthSerial = key => {
  const [year, month] = key.split("-").map(Number)
  return year * 12 + month
}

monthDate = key => new Date(key + "-01T00:00:00Z")

shiftMonth = (key, offset) => {
  const [year, month] = key.split("-").map(Number)
  return d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m")(new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1 + offset, 1)))
}

monthLabel = key => d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(monthDate(key))
monthShortLabel = key => d3.utcFormat("%b")(monthDate(key))

monthRangeLabel = months => {
  if (!months?.length) return ""
  const start = monthDate(months[0])
  const end = monthDate(months[months.length - 1])
  const sameYear = d3.utcFormat("%Y")(start) === d3.utcFormat("%Y")(end)
  return sameYear
    ? d3.utcFormat("%B")(start) + "\u2013" + d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(end)
    : d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(start) + "\u2013" + d3.utcFormat("%B %Y")(end)
}

rowReady = row => Boolean(row) && complete(row) && isPublishedNumber(row)

onlyOne = (rows, label) => {
  if (rows.length !== 1) throw new Error(label + ": expected one public row per month.")
  return rows[0]
}

formatCount = value =>
  Number.isFinite(Number(value))
    ? Math.round(Number(value)).toLocaleString("en-GB")
    : "Unavailable"

definitionCode = choice =>
  choice === "Inclusive"
    ? "upper_clear_likely_possible"
    : "primary_clear_likely"
```

```{ojs}
  row.sex === "all" &&

)

mortalityRows = mortalityMetrics.filter(row =>
  row.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
  row.period_type === "monthly" &&
  row.event_type === "all_cvd" &&
  row.sex === "all" &&
  row.age_group === "all" &&
  (row.case_definition === "primary_clear_likely" ||
   row.case_definition === "upper_clear_likely_possible") &&
  row.statistic === "monthly_count"
)

eventByMonth = d3.rollup(eventRows, rows => onlyOne(rows, "Events"), monthKey)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
selectedMortalityRows = mortalityRows.filter(row =>
  row.case_definition === definitionCode(mortalityCardChoice)
)

mortalityByMonth = d3.rollup(
  selectedMortalityRows,
  rows => onlyOne(rows, "Mortality"),
  monthKey
)

commonMonths = Array.from(eventByMonth.keys())
  .filter(key => mortalityByMonth.has(key))
  .sort()

eligibleMonths = commonMonths.filter(key =>
  rowReady(eventByMonth.get(key)) &&
  rowReady(mortalityByMonth.get(key))
)

latestMonth = eligibleMonths.length
  ? eligibleMonths[eligibleMonths.length - 1]
  : null

latestSummary = latestMonth
  ? {
      month: latestMonth,
      events: Number(eventByMonth.get(latestMonth).display_value),
      deaths: Number(mortalityByMonth.get(latestMonth).display_value)
    }
  : null

lastThreeMonths = latestMonth
  ? [-2, -1, 0].map(offset => shiftMonth(latestMonth, offset))
  : []

lastThreeReady =
  lastThreeMonths.length === 3 &&
  lastThreeMonths.every(key =>
    rowReady(eventByMonth.get(key)) &&
    rowReady(mortalityByMonth.get(key))
  )

lastThreeSummary = lastThreeReady
  ? {
      months: lastThreeMonths,
      events: d3.sum(lastThreeMonths, key => Number(eventByMonth.get(key).display_value)),
      deaths: d3.sum(lastThreeMonths, key => Number(mortalityByMonth.get(key).display_value))
    }
  : null
```

```{ojs}
summaryCard = ({kind, label, value, note}) => {
  const card = document.createElement("div")
  card.className = "bnr-update-summary-card bnr-update-" + kind + "-card"

  const labelNode = document.createElement("div")
  labelNode.className = "bnr-update-card-label"
  labelNode.textContent = label

  const valueNode = document.createElement("div")
  valueNode.className = "bnr-update-card-value"
  valueNode.textContent = formatCount(value)

  const noteNode = document.createElement("div")
  noteNode.className = "bnr-update-card-note"
  noteNode.textContent = note

  card.append(labelNode, valueNode, noteNode)
  return card
}

summaryGrid = cards => {
  const grid = document.createElement("div")
  grid.className = "bnr-update-card-grid"
  cards.forEach(card => grid.append(card))
  return grid
}

availabilityNotice = text => {
  const note = document.createElement("div")
  note.className = "bnr-update-unavailable"
  note.textContent = text
  return note
}
```

## Rolling 12-month trend

Choose between a cumulative total and the difference from the 2015–2019 average
for the same calendar month. In the difference view, the horizontal zero line is
the 2015–2019 monthly average: values above zero are higher than that reference
and values below zero are lower. Background lines show aligned 12-month periods
from earlier years. Only complete published values are used.

```{ojs}
//| output: false
referenceYears = d3.range(2015, 2020)
referencePeriodLabel = "2015–2019"

calendarMonthNumber = key => Number(String(key).slice(5, 7))

monthlyReferenceAverage = byMonth => {
  const reference = new Map()

  d3.range(1, 13).forEach(month => {
    const keys = referenceYears.map(year =>
      String(year) + "-" + String(month).padStart(2, "0")
    )
    const rows = keys.map(key => byMonth.get(key))

    // The reference is shown only when all five published reference-year values
    // are complete and available. Missing or protected values are never filled in.
    if (!rows.every(rowReady)) {
      reference.set(month, null)
      return
    }

    reference.set(
      month,
      d3.mean(rows, row => Number(row.display_value))
    )
  })

  return reference
}

rollingBlock = (byMonth, endMonth, yearsBack = 0) => {
  if (!endMonth) return null

  const shiftedEnd = shiftMonth(endMonth, -12 * yearsBack)
  const months = d3.range(-11, 1).map(offset => shiftMonth(shiftedEnd, offset))

  if (!months.every(key => rowReady(byMonth.get(key)))) return null

  const series = monthRangeLabel(months)
  const startYear = months[0].slice(0, 4)
  const endYear = months[months.length - 1].slice(0, 4)
  const seriesYearRange = startYear === endYear ? startYear : startYear + "\u2013" + endYear
  let cumulative = 0

  return months.map((month, index) => {
    const monthlyCount = Number(byMonth.get(month).display_value)
    cumulative += monthlyCount
    return {
      axisMonth: monthShortLabel(month),
      cumulative,
      monthlyCount,
      month,
      series,
      seriesYearRange,
      seriesType: yearsBack === 0 ? "current" : "historical_comparator",
      yearsBack,
      step: index + 1
    }
  })
}

differenceBlock = (byMonth, referenceByCalendarMonth, endMonth, yearsBack = 0) => {
  if (!endMonth) return null

  const shiftedEnd = shiftMonth(endMonth, -12 * yearsBack)
  const months = d3.range(-11, 1).map(offset => shiftMonth(shiftedEnd, offset))

  if (!months.every(key => rowReady(byMonth.get(key)))) return null
  if (!months.every(key => Number.isFinite(referenceByCalendarMonth.get(calendarMonthNumber(key))))) return null

  const series = monthRangeLabel(months)
  const startYear = months[0].slice(0, 4)
  const endYear = months[months.length - 1].slice(0, 4)
  const seriesYearRange = startYear === endYear ? startYear : startYear + "\u2013" + endYear

  return months.map((month, index) => {
    const monthlyCount = Number(byMonth.get(month).display_value)
    const referenceAverage = Number(referenceByCalendarMonth.get(calendarMonthNumber(month)))
    return {
      axisMonth: monthShortLabel(month),
      monthlyCount,
      referenceAverage,
      difference: monthlyCount - referenceAverage,
      month,
      series,
      seriesYearRange,
      seriesType: yearsBack === 0 ? "current" : "historical_comparator",
      yearsBack,
      step: index + 1
    }
  })
}

rollingComparators = (byMonth, endMonth) => {
  if (!endMonth || !byMonth.size) return []

  const earliestSerial = d3.min(Array.from(byMonth.keys()), monthSerial)
  const maximumYearsBack = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.floor((monthSerial(endMonth) - earliestSerial) / 12)
  )

  return d3.range(1, maximumYearsBack + 1)
    .map(yearsBack => rollingBlock(byMonth, endMonth, yearsBack))
    .filter(block => block !== null)
}

differenceComparators = (byMonth, referenceByCalendarMonth, endMonth) => {
  if (!endMonth || !byMonth.size) return []

  const earliestSerial = d3.min(Array.from(byMonth.keys()), monthSerial)
  const maximumYearsBack = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.floor((monthSerial(endMonth) - earliestSerial) / 12)
  )

  return d3.range(1, maximumYearsBack + 1)
    .map(yearsBack => differenceBlock(byMonth, referenceByCalendarMonth, endMonth, yearsBack))
    .filter(block => block !== null)
}

eventChartEligibleMonths = Array.from(eventByMonth.keys())
  .filter(key => rowReady(eventByMonth.get(key)))
  .sort()

eventChartLatestMonth = eventChartEligibleMonths.length
  ? eventChartEligibleMonths[eventChartEligibleMonths.length - 1]
  : null

eventReferenceByMonth = monthlyReferenceAverage(eventByMonth)
eventRollingCurrent = rollingBlock(eventByMonth, eventChartLatestMonth, 0)
eventRollingComparators = rollingComparators(eventByMonth, eventChartLatestMonth)
eventDifferenceCurrent = differenceBlock(
  eventByMonth,
  eventReferenceByMonth,
  eventChartLatestMonth,
  0
)
eventDifferenceComparators = differenceComparators(
  eventByMonth,
  eventReferenceByMonth,
  eventChartLatestMonth
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
formatOneDecimal = value =>
  Number.isFinite(Number(value)) ? Number(value).toFixed(1) : "Unavailable"

formatSignedOneDecimal = value => {
  if (!Number.isFinite(Number(value))) return "Unavailable"
  const number = Number(value)
  if (Math.abs(number) < 0.05) return "0.0"
  return (number > 0 ? "+" : "\u2212") + Math.abs(number).toFixed(1)
}

cumulativeTrendPlot = (current, comparators, plotWidth, yDomainMaximum = null) => {
  if (!current) return null

  const historical = comparators.flat()
  const interactive = [
    ...historical.map(row => ({
      ...row,
      hoverTitle: row.seriesYearRange
    })),
    ...current.map(row => ({
      ...row,
      hoverTitle:
        "Current period\n" +
        monthLabel(row.month) + "\n" +
        "Monthly count: " + formatCount(row.monthlyCount) + "\n" +
        "Cumulative count: " + formatCount(row.cumulative)
    }))
  ]

  const marks = [Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#d8e0e4"})]

  if (historical.length) {
    marks.push(
      Plot.line(historical, {
        x: "axisMonth",
        y: "cumulative",
        z: "series",
        stroke: "#607780",
        strokeOpacity: 0.18,
        strokeWidth: 1.25
      })
    )
  }

  marks.push(
    Plot.line(current, {
      x: "axisMonth",
      y: "cumulative",
      stroke: "#045174",
      strokeWidth: 3
    })
  )

  marks.push(
    Plot.tip(
      interactive,
      Plot.pointerX({
        x: "axisMonth",
        y: "cumulative",
        title: "hoverTitle"
      })
    )
  )

  marks.push(
    Plot.dot(current.slice(-1), {
      x: "axisMonth",
      y: "cumulative",
      fill: "#045174",
      r: 4
    })
  )

  const yOptions = {
    grid: true,
    label: null,
    nice: true
  }
  if (
    yDomainMaximum !== null &&
    yDomainMaximum !== undefined &&
    Number.isFinite(Number(yDomainMaximum)) &&
    Number(yDomainMaximum) > 0
  ) {
    yOptions.domain = [0, Number(yDomainMaximum)]
  }

  return Plot.plot({
    width: plotWidth,
    height: 340,
    marginLeft: 62,
    marginRight: 22,
    marginBottom: 42,
    style: {
      fontFamily: "inherit",
      fontSize: "13px",
      background: "transparent"
    },
    x: {
      domain: current.map(row => row.axisMonth),
      label: null
    },
    y: yOptions,
    marks
  })
}

differenceAxisLimit = blocks => {
  const values = blocks
    .filter(Boolean)
    .flat()
    .map(row => Math.abs(Number(row.difference)))
    .filter(Number.isFinite)
  return values.length ? d3.max(values) : null
}

differenceTrendPlot = (current, comparators, plotWidth, sharedAxisLimit = null) => {
  if (!current) return null

  const historical = comparators.flat()
  const interactive = [
    ...historical.map(row => ({
      ...row,
      hoverTitle: row.seriesYearRange
    })),
    ...current.map(row => ({
      ...row,
      hoverTitle:
        "Current period\n" +
        monthLabel(row.month) + "\n" +
        "Monthly count: " + formatCount(row.monthlyCount) + "\n" +
        referencePeriodLabel + " average: " + formatOneDecimal(row.referenceAverage) + "\n" +
        "Difference: " + formatSignedOneDecimal(row.difference)
    }))
  ]

  const marks = [
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#7f8c93", strokeWidth: 1.5})
  ]

  if (historical.length) {
    marks.push(
      Plot.line(historical, {
        x: "axisMonth",
        y: "difference",
        z: "series",
        stroke: "#607780",
        strokeOpacity: 0.18,
        strokeWidth: 1.25
      })
    )
  }

  marks.push(
    Plot.line(current, {
      x: "axisMonth",
      y: "difference",
      stroke: "#045174",
      strokeWidth: 3
    })
  )

  marks.push(
    Plot.tip(
      interactive,
      Plot.pointerX({
        x: "axisMonth",
        y: "difference",
        title: "hoverTitle"
      })
    )
  )

  marks.push(
    Plot.dot(current.slice(-1), {
      x: "axisMonth",
      y: "difference",
      fill: "#045174",
      r: 4
    })
  )

  const calculatedLimit = differenceAxisLimit([current, ...comparators])
  const axisLimit =
    sharedAxisLimit !== null &&
    sharedAxisLimit !== undefined &&
    Number.isFinite(Number(sharedAxisLimit)) &&
    Number(sharedAxisLimit) > 0
      ? Number(sharedAxisLimit)
      : calculatedLimit

  const yOptions = {
    grid: true,
    label: null,
    nice: true
  }
  if (Number.isFinite(Number(axisLimit)) && Number(axisLimit) > 0) {
    yOptions.domain = [-Number(axisLimit), Number(axisLimit)]
  }

  return Plot.plot({
    width: plotWidth,
    height: 340,
    marginLeft: 62,
    marginRight: 22,
    marginBottom: 42,
    style: {
      fontFamily: "inherit",
      fontSize: "13px",
      background: "transparent"
    },
    x: {
      domain: current.map(row => row.axisMonth),
      label: null
    },
    y: yOptions,
    marks
  })
}

rollingSummaryText = (current, subject) => {
  if (!current) {
    return "A complete 12-month series is not available for " + subject + "."
  }
  const total = current[current.length - 1].cumulative
  return monthRangeLabel(current.map(row => row.month)) + ": " +
    formatCount(total) + " " + subject + "."
}

differenceSummaryText = (current, subject) => {
  if (!current) {
    return "A complete 12-month difference series is not available for " + subject + "."
  }
  return monthRangeLabel(current.map(row => row.month)) +
    ": monthly counts compared with the " + referencePeriodLabel +
    " average for the same calendar month."
}

chartExportRows = ({blocks, chartView, measure, sourceReleaseId, sourceSnapshot, ascertainmentScope = "", mortalityDefinition = "", mortalityDefinitionCode = ""}) =>
  blocks.filter(Boolean).flat().map(row => ({
    report_id: "bnr_cvd_update_2026_01_v9",
    report_version: "v9",
    report_date: "2026-09-03",
    report_period: "January 2026",
    source_release_id: sourceReleaseId,
    source_snapshot: sourceSnapshot,
    chart_view: chartView,
    reference_period: row.referenceAverage === undefined ? "" : referencePeriodLabel,
    measure,
    ascertainment_scope: ascertainmentScope,
    mortality_definition: mortalityDefinition,
    mortality_definition_code: mortalityDefinitionCode,
    series_type: row.seriesType,
    series_period: row.series,
    series_year_range: row.seriesYearRange,
    years_back: row.yearsBack,
    month: row.month,
    month_label: monthLabel(row.month),
    month_number_in_series: row.step,
    monthly_count: row.monthlyCount,
    reference_monthly_average: row.referenceAverage === undefined ? "" : row.referenceAverage,
    difference_from_reference: row.difference === undefined ? "" : row.difference,
    cumulative_count: row.cumulative === undefined ? "" : row.cumulative
  }))

csvEscape = value => {
  const text = value === null || value === undefined ? "" : String(value)
  return /[",\r\n]/.test(text) ? `"${text.replaceAll('"', '""')}"` : text
}

chartCsv = rows => {
  if (!rows.length) return ""
  const headers = Object.keys(rows[0])
  return [
    headers.map(csvEscape).join(","),
    ...rows.map(row => headers.map(key => csvEscape(row[key])).join(","))
  ].join("\r\n")
}

downloadLink = (csv, filename, linkText = "Download chart data (CSV)") => {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"}))
  const link = document.createElement("a")
  link.className = "bnr-update-data-download"
  link.href = url
  link.download = filename
  link.textContent = linkText
  return {link, url}
}

sourceCsvWithMetadata = ({rows, sourceReleaseId, sourceSnapshot, sourceType, publishedSourceHref}) => {
  if (!rows?.length) return ""

  const metadataHeaders = [
    "report_id",
    "report_version",
    "report_date",
    "report_period",
    "source_type",
    "source_release_id",
    "source_release",
    "source_snapshot",
    "published_source_href"
  ]
  const sourceHeaders = rows.columns?.length ? rows.columns : Object.keys(rows[0])
  const headers = [...metadataHeaders, ...sourceHeaders]

  return [
    headers.map(csvEscape).join(","),
    ...rows.map(row => {
      const metadata = {
        report_id: "bnr_cvd_update_2026_01_v9",
        report_version: "v9",
        report_date: "2026-09-03",
        report_period: "January 2026",
        source_type: sourceType,
        source_release_id: sourceReleaseId,
        source_release: releaseDescriptor(sourceReleaseId),
        source_snapshot: sourceSnapshot,
        published_source_href: publishedSourceHref
      }
      return headers.map(key =>
        csvEscape(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(metadata, key) ? metadata[key] : row[key])
      ).join(",")
    })
  ].join("\r\n")
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mortalityChartRows = mortalityRows.filter(row =>
  row.case_definition === definitionCode(mortalityChartChoice)
)

mortalityChartByMonth = d3.rollup(
  mortalityChartRows,
  rows => onlyOne(rows, "Mortality chart"),
  monthKey
)

mortalityChartEligibleMonths = Array.from(mortalityChartByMonth.keys())
  .filter(key => rowReady(mortalityChartByMonth.get(key)))
  .sort()

mortalityChartLatestMonth = mortalityChartEligibleMonths.length
  ? mortalityChartEligibleMonths[mortalityChartEligibleMonths.length - 1]
  : null

mortalityChartReferenceByMonth = monthlyReferenceAverage(mortalityChartByMonth)

mortalityRollingCurrent = rollingBlock(
  mortalityChartByMonth,
  mortalityChartLatestMonth,
  0
)
mortalityRollingComparators = rollingComparators(
  mortalityChartByMonth,
  mortalityChartLatestMonth
)
mortalityDifferenceCurrent = differenceBlock(
  mortalityChartByMonth,
  mortalityChartReferenceByMonth,
  mortalityChartLatestMonth,
  0
)
mortalityDifferenceComparators = differenceComparators(
  mortalityChartByMonth,
  mortalityChartReferenceByMonth,
  mortalityChartLatestMonth
)

// Use common y-axis limits for Primary and Inclusive so switching mortality
// definition does not rescale either chart view.
mortalityAxisDefinitions = ["Primary", "Inclusive"].map(choice => {
  const rows = mortalityRows.filter(row =>
    row.case_definition === definitionCode(choice)
  )
  const byMonth = d3.rollup(
    rows,
    group => onlyOne(group, "Mortality axis"),
    monthKey
  )
  const eligible = Array.from(byMonth.keys())
    .filter(key => rowReady(byMonth.get(key)))
    .sort()
  const latest = eligible.length ? eligible[eligible.length - 1] : null
  const reference = monthlyReferenceAverage(byMonth)
  const cumulativeBlocks = [
    rollingBlock(byMonth, latest, 0),
    ...rollingComparators(byMonth, latest)
  ].filter(Boolean)
  const differenceBlocks = [
    differenceBlock(byMonth, reference, latest, 0),
    ...differenceComparators(byMonth, reference, latest)
  ].filter(Boolean)
  return {cumulativeBlocks, differenceBlocks}
})

mortalityCumulativeAxisValues = mortalityAxisDefinitions
  .flatMap(item => item.cumulativeBlocks)
  .flat()
  .map(row => Number(row.cumulative))
  .filter(Number.isFinite)

mortalitySharedYMaximum = mortalityCumulativeAxisValues.length
  ? d3.max(mortalityCumulativeAxisValues)
  : null

mortalityDifferenceAxisValues = mortalityAxisDefinitions
  .flatMap(item => item.differenceBlocks)
  .flat()
  .map(row => Math.abs(Number(row.difference)))
  .filter(Number.isFinite)

mortalitySharedDifferenceLimit = mortalityDifferenceAxisValues.length
  ? d3.max(mortalityDifferenceAxisValues)
  : null
```

All event counts are hospital-recorded. Death counts use the selected Primary or
Inclusive mortality definition. Monthly, three-month and cumulative 12-month
totals are calculated only from published display values that are complete and
not suppressed; unavailable values are never inferred.

The full-release and chart-data CSVs are browser-generated convenience downloads
from the frozen snapshots stored with this dated report. They add report and
release metadata but do not replace the authoritative published release files.
:::
